title: Need for Speed: Rivals

engine.name: Frostbite 3
engine.evidence: Data/cas.cat plus numbered .cas archives (content-addressed storage), Core/Qt* runtime for the shell, Core/Activation*.dll, d3dcompiler_46.dll, __Installer and __overlay folders.
engine.notes: Two executables ship: NFS14.exe (x64) and NFS14_x86.exe (x86). Both load an activation library, which is the interesting part for offline operation.

userState.evidence: publisher convention (Ghost Games folder under My Documents); not present on this machine yet

dependencies.communityReplacement: TurboRivals (unofficial community AllDrive replacement; not needed for solo play, not verified here)
dependencies.notes: EA switched off Rivals' online services on 2025-10-07, so these endpoints are dead by publisher decision rather than by failure.

dependencies.evidence: both executables import an activation library; Steam's store page still states an EA account is required
dependencies.notes: Whether a fully offline launch passes this gate is unknown. It is treated as mandatory and unmeasured rather than assumed either way.

staticAnalysis.method: PE header/import parse plus ASCII string scan of both executables
staticAnalysis.limits: Activation logic is inside Core/Activation*.dll, which has not been parsed. No runtime observation yet.

notes: Solo AllDrive against AI is a designed mode, but the account/activation gate has to be measured before any offline claim.
